name: Artificial Vermilion
lede: Artificial vermilion is the same red mercury sulphide as natural cinnabar, made by combining mercury and sulphur, and for centuries it cost far less than the mineral.

sections.title: One compound, two sources
sections.body:
Vermilion is mercuric sulphide, found as the mineral cinnabar and also made by hand [1]. The artist and writer Jarman says the artificial kind is identical to the natural one, though not in price [1]. He gives 250 grams of the artificial at £10 against £250 for the natural [1].

The pigment compendium notes that English used cinnabar and vermilion interchangeably for either form for a long time [2]. By the seventeenth century vermilion was the more common word, and Browne in 1669 spoke of artificial vermilion and native cinnabar [2]. Only from the second half of the eighteenth century was cinnabar reserved for the unground native mineral [2].

sections.title: In the workshop and the alchemist's lab
sections.body:
Gage lists artificial vermilion, made from sulphur and mercury, among the oldest manufactured pigments [3]. He links it to alchemy, where the two ingredients were thought to be the basic components of metals [3]. He also suggests that this helps explain why red and gold were equated in alchemical work [3].

Cennini, Gage notes, skipped the complicated recipes, telling the painter to make friends with someone who knew them, perhaps the Florentine Jesuati [3]. Leonardo da Vinci's notebooks show he was curious about how painting materials work [3].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: The swatch on this page, #986D77, is a muted rose-brown and not the bright red most people picture as vermilion [4]. In our archive of 23,781 paintings, 42 contain it, as photographed [4]. It is most often a hidden color inside a painting, and the name is first recorded in the 1930 Maerz and Paul dictionary [4].

questions.q: How does artificial vermilion differ chemically from natural cinnabar?
choices: It does not; it is the same compound
It is a different, weaker mercury salt
It contains lead instead of mercury
questions.answer: It does not; it is the same compound

questions.q: By when did English reserve the word cinnabar for the native mineral?

openers: Artificial and natural vermilion are the same compound; the natural cost far more.
